dynamic_scale_negative_fixture.prove: Let W_fixed = q.float()*s. BitLinear path: write master:=W_fixed then call quantize_weight → scale_dyn = master.abs().mean(); W_dyn = round(master/scale_dyn).clamp(-1,1)*scale_dyn. ASSERT scale_dyn != s (bit-unequal) AND NOT torch.allclose(W_dyn, W_fixed) AND NOT torch.allclose(F.linear(x,W_dyn), F.linear(x,W_fixed)). Degenerate output-equality alone is insufficient — weight AND output must differ by construction.
